falsifier: Fails if the CP lower endpoint remains below nominal 0.975, or if the median block-bootstrap radius is not larger than the i.i.d. radius at n=60000.
method_description: Each sample is partitioned into contiguous B=64 blocks; B-sized blocks are resampled with replacement, with a residual block to preserve n=60000. The radius is recomputed per replicate.
notes: Median radius is larger than the i.i.d. reference; CP lower endpoint clears nominal 0.975; Required replicates recomputed from p0=0.95, p1=0.9825, two-sided alpha=0.05, target power=0.95: ceil(N)=800; the displayed dispatcher approximation 897 does not follow from the displayed formula, which evaluates to 799.44.
radius_description: r_boot = Quantile_0.975(|TV_hat_boot - TV_hat|) over 128 block-bootstrap resamples.

required_replicates_labelled.note: Correct structure for this test. The earlier field value 800 used the two-sample pooled form, which is conservative here by 2.04x; it does not invalidate any run (1000 replicates were used) but must not be quoted as the requirement for this coverage test. Two-sample equivalent = 800.
